verdict.rationale: The evidence documents that the Angular CLI builds and serves apps with rebuilds on file changes, but nothing describes the content, clarity or actionability of dev-server or build error messages. One community report (Angular 2 era) says template typos produced no compile-time or runtime error at all, which points away from the capability rather than supporting it. With no vendor claim to contradict, this is not a dispute.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get clear, actionable error messages from the dev server and build tool when something breaks
